source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES submits HSC1~HSC10 as one literal record and truncates discovery. It neither expands ten channels nor defines HSC, controller-to-power-tree topology, measured quantity, scaling or applicable limits.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires ten separate records and HSC/topology semantics. The preserved V3.1 review additionally requires upstream-feed/downstream-domain causality and keeps this passive display row separate from load/trip behavior and PWR_STBY_HSC.

old_problem: Ten similarly named HSC records cannot be judged by count or adjacency: numbering may not follow the schematic, identical controllers may protect different rails, and input power/current-derived power is not automatically equivalent to downstream GPU/module telemetry. The source also does not authorize load, trip or hot-swap stimulus.
disposition_reason: Create ten independent controller/domain rows keyed by approved designator, physical location, upstream feed and downstream protected load. Define HSC and each controller's quantity/register/scaling from Project power-tree evidence, then compare complete passive OOB and UI data with controller/domain/state-specific rules. Missing schematic/runtime bindings is execution NOT READY, not a remaining engineering decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 900, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, selection manifest, related dynamic HSC case, following standby-HSC case and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed.
HSC may plausibly mean hot-swap controller, but its abbreviation, controller identity and power-tree association are OEM/Project facts and are not expanded from the label alone.
The related dynamic case supports power-domain context but does not authorize connector load changes, trip tests or recovery actions here; PWR_STBY_HSC is a separate source identity.
ED-03 forbids guessed OEM registers, ED-15 requires per-domain approved criteria, ED-17 preserves fault evidence and ED-20 preserves all ten domains separately.

test_case.test_name: Verify PWR_GB_HSC1 through PWR_GB_HSC10 as ten mapped power-controller domains
test_case.purpose: Verify all ten Project-defined GB HSC power records are separately present or have approved population/state outcomes and correctly display controller/domain identity, measured quantity, units, value, health, supported thresholds and freshness in Dashboard and Server Health for the unchanged current feed/load state.
required_package: Chassis/GPU-baseboard/BMC identity and authoritative HSC abbreviation/function
Ten-row controller PN/revision/serial or schematic designator, physical location, upstream feed and downstream module/connector/rail/population map
Per-controller management bus/mux/address/channel/register, measured electrical boundary and quantity/units
Scaling, calibration tolerance, averaging/sample window, polling/update rate and stable SDR/API/UI identities
Per-domain normal range, tolerance/limit, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, status, stale/zero/unavailable and powered-off rules
Recorded PSU feeds/redundancy, HSC enable/fault state, GPU/module population and current host/load/cooling context
Validated protected read-only BMC/browser client and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL, controller-fault, kernel, power or thermal logs and do not vary connector load, stress GPU/modules, trip/reset a controller, disconnect feeds, power-cycle, change thresholds or flash firmware. Confirm HSC and the ten-row power-tree/controller map first. Enumerate the complete sensor repository and query PWR_GB_HSC1 through PWR_GB_HSC10 as exact separate records; never use the tilde string as one sensor or infer topology from numbering. Review the Script before use. Capture each controller/domain identity, upstream/downstream boundary, quantity/units, value, supported thresholds, health and synchronized timestamp plus matching Dashboard and Server Health rows and unchanged feed/load state. Apply its own approved state rule and stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Ten explicit, mutually distinct domain outcomes match the approved controller and power-tree map. Every applicable raw record and both UI views agree on controller/domain, electrical boundary, quantity, units, value, supported thresholds, health and freshness and satisfy the controller/domain/current-state rule. Unfitted/off/standby/zero/unavailable behavior is accepted only when specified; PWR_STBY_HSC, aggregate power or downstream GPU telemetry does not substitute.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the approved HSC definition and ten-row controller/feed/load map plus complete independent OOB/two-UI evidence accepted against per-controller boundary/state rules. A literal range, first-100-line fallback, count, numbering assumption, aggregate or PWR_STBY_HSC evidence, or cross-boundary numeric similarity cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale identity, wrong boundary/unit/scaling, out-of-rule value or required UI/status/threshold mismatch is FAIL. Missing power tree, controller/register semantics or acceptance is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS. Inrush, overload/trip/retry and hot-swap recovery are outside this passive row.
safety_gate: Preserve SEL, controller-fault, kernel, power and thermal history; do not execute the source's generic clear-log step.
Do not assume HSC expansion or controller-to-domain mapping from numbering; require schematic and fitted hardware identity.
Keep all ten domains and PWR_STBY_HSC distinct; do not compare controller input and downstream device power without approved boundary/window accounting.
Do not add load, trip/reset a controller, disconnect a feed, power-cycle/reseat hardware, change thresholds or flash firmware.
Do not guess OEM registers, truncate output, expose credentials, assume a cipher or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard/BMC identity and approved HSC definition
Per-controller bus/mux/address/channel/register, quantity/boundary, units, scaling/calibration/window and stable SDR/UI mapping
Complete separate raw values, supported thresholds, health and synchronized timestamps plus matching Dashboard and Server Health visual evidence
Recorded PSU/feed/redundancy, HSC enable/fault, GPU/module population, host/load/cooling context and state-specific comparisons
Unfitted/off/standby/zero/unavailable/stale/faulted/divergent disposition, Script/client audit, no-mutation/no-retry proof, final power/BMC health and ten-domain engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The method is read-only. On unknown HSC semantics, topology or telemetry boundary, or on a fault/stale/divergent result, stop and preserve first-pass evidence and feed/load/controller state. Obtain the Project schematic and controller reference and continue only with approved passive diagnostics; never trip or reset a controller to make the row pass. Any separately authorized load or protection test requires isolation, authorization and its own recovery.

source_conflict.reason: HSC and the power tree are undefined, but Items, Sensor Page navigation and Criteria consistently request passive presentation of ten power channels. Dynamic HSC and standby-HSC rows are separate coverage, not conflicting requirements.

blocked.reason: The ten-channel passive objective and safety boundary are clear. Project schematic/controller data can provide topology and acceptance at runtime.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: HSC definition, ten controller/location/feed/downstream-domain mappings, controller registers/quantity/scaling/window, stable IDs, per-domain state/limit/threshold/status/freshness rules, passive feed/load context and protected reviewed method.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ ONLY; NO LOAD, TRIP, RESET, FEED, POWER, THRESHOLD OR FIRMWARE CHANGE; SCRIPT NOT APPROVED
